Same-day arm rate 68.9% (45 closes today) is the companion reading only — brain_auditor #196 showed it does not forecast next-day PnL. Shadow auto-trader scorecard independently agrees with the direction story: longs 4W/17T 23.5% -0.129, shorts 6W/13T 46.2% +0.168, all in CHOP.
